17:1.text: [above all that (evil) they associate with Him]
for a journey by night from Al-Masjid-al-Harâm
, the neighbourhood whereof We have blessed, in order that We might show him
. Verily, He is the All-Hearer, the All-Seer

17:2.text: the Scripture and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel
(Protector, Lord or Disposer of your affairs)

17:3.text: "O offspring of those whom We carried
! Verily, he was a grateful slave."

17:4.text: And We decreed for the Children of Israel in the Scripture: indeed you would do mischief in the land twice and you will become tyrants and extremely arrogant!

17:5.text: So, when the promise came for the first of the two, We sent against you slaves of Ours given to terrible warfare. They entered the very innermost parts of your homes. And it was a promise

17:6.text: Then We gave you a return of victory over them. And We helped you with wealth and children and made you more numerous in man-power.

17:7.text: : "If you do good, you do good for your ownselves, and if you do evil
against yourselves." Then, when the second promise came to pass,
to disgrace your faces and to enter the mosque
as they had entered it before, and to destroy with utter destruction all that fell in their hands.
